en.topic_title: Taiwan Indigenous farmer revives climate-resilient millet
en.topic_summary:
Indigenous farmer Banu Ismahasan walks through a golden field of tall stalks in southeastern Taiwan, harvesting by hand the grain heads of an ancient crop resistant to extreme weather.



Taiwan farmer Banu Ismahasan spreads freshly harvested oil millet out to dry in the sun in Taitung on October 21, 2026. Photo: I-Hwa Cheng / AFP
